description: What each refusal and each test not checked in the replay's ledgers waits on: an issue, or the reason sverify-dbt does not check it by design. sverify_dbt.replay reads it; a reason that names an issue itself (#n) needs no entry.

constructs.design: a test of two relations is not a condition on one model's output; sverify-dbt checks one model at a time, and dbt still runs it
a lower bound on distinct values is not a condition sverify proves; dbt still runs it
a project's own generic test: sverify-dbt maps the tests of dbt, dbt-utils and dbt-expectations; the project can state it as dbt_utils.expression_is_true
a random value differs on every run, so no proof covers the model
the time differs on every run, so no proof covers the model

constructs.match: no compiled SQL in the manifest
constructs.design: dbt itself fails to build the model on DuckDB

constructs.match: DuckDB cannot plan the compiled SQL
constructs.design: DuckDB itself refuses the compiled SQL

constructs.match: dbt runs no test on an ephemeral model
constructs.design: dbt does not run the test

constructs.match: casts to FLOAT (fp32) are not modelled

constructs.design: a regex flag changes what the pattern matches; sverify's regexp functions take no flags, and dbt still runs the test

constructs.match: not on a model sverify-dbt reports
constructs.design: sverify-dbt reports the tests of models; a test on a snapshot, a seed's own column or another node is dbt's
the test names a column the model does not have, which dbt itself reports

constructs.match: the compiled SQL does not parse: Error tokenizing
constructs.design: another adapter's SQL (a backslash-escaped quote) that DuckDB does not read either

constructs.match: which is no ref or source of the model
constructs.design: a table no ref() or source() names (dbt-core's suite creates it outside dbt): sverify-dbt reads a model's inputs through ref() and source(), whose tests it assumes; dbt still runs the test

constructs.match: sverify proves no foreign keys of a model's result
constructs.design: a foreign key relates two relations, and sverify-dbt proves conditions on one model's result; dbt still runs it

constructs.match: its columns are no list of column names
constructs.design: a column list with a null or a bare string names no columns to check; dbt itself fails such a test, so sverify-dbt does not read it
